agenda_text:
THE LONG BEACH COMMUNITY
  INVESTMENT COMPANY AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 21, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  BEACH CONFERENCE ROOM, 2ND FLOOR, 4:00 PM

Mary Castro, Chair  Eva Melgarejo, Director
Hilda Delgado, Vice Chair  Alejandra Ramirez, Director
Hakim Chambers, Director  Elwood Sides, Director
Jasmine Esparza, Director

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS
  AND EMAIL COMMENTS TO MONICA.JAIME@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-52259  Recommendation to receive and file President’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-52260  Recommendation to approve the minutes of the Long Beach Community
  Investment Company meeting on January 17, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-52262  Recommendation to receive and file the Housing Successor Annual Report
  Regarding the Low- and Moderate-Income Housing Asset Fund for Fiscal Year
  2022-2023 and direct the President to post and distribute the report as required by
  Section 34176.1 of the California Health and Safety Code. (Citywide)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-52263  Recommendation to approve a contract with Linc Housing Corporation in the
  amount of up to $343,365 for the demolition of two structures at 4151 E. Fountain
  Street;

  Approve an up to $343,365 increase to the loan to Linc Housing Corporation; and,

  Authorize the President or designee to execute any and all documents necessary
  related to the demolition contract and loan increase.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please call the Community Development at (562) 570-3807 or (562)
570-6957.
